periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree downward tilt relative to the horizontal facial axis towards the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovoid shape with a vertical-to-horizontal ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward taper, extending below the horizontal midline of the ocular region.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shape profile at the posterior margin of the dorsal band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Extends approximately one-third of the total visible torso length from the shoulder line.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral placement with a gap approximately equal to twice the width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Rounded convex curvature at the superior margin of the pinna.

other_distinctive_markers: A thin, straight bamboo or wooden twig is held horizontally across the oral cavity.
